newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise seeks big Euro telecoms allies.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise seeks big Euro telecoms allies.

text.p: French conglomerate Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Thursday it was actively seeking large partners in France or beyond to become a major player in the European telecoms and communications sector.

"The resources needed and the speed of development have led the group to actively seek large partners in France or abroad to become a significant European player in this sector," chairman Jerome Monod said.

He told a news conference that the return to breakeven of his group's cable activities, the success of the M6 television station, a good start for the TPS satellite TV consortium as well as deregulation of the telephone market "underlines our conviction in this domain".
